content: कुलम् .²1 A race, family; निदानमिक्ष्वाकुकुलस्य संततेः <ls>R. 3. 1</ls>. .²2 The residence of a family, a seat, house, an abode; ददर्श धीमान्स कपिः कुलानि <ls>Rām. 5. 5. 10</ls>; वसन्नृषिकुलेषु सः <ls>R. 12. 25</ls>. .²3 A high or noble family, noble descent; कुले जन्म <ls>Pt. 5. 2</ls>; कुलशीलसमन्वितः <ls>Ms. 7. 54</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 7.">62</ls>; so कुलजा, कुलकन्यका <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A herd, troop, flock; collection, multitude; मृगकुलं रोमन्थमभ्यस्यतु <ls>Ś. 2. 6</ls>; <ls>U. 2. 9</ls>; अलिकुलसंकुल <ls>Gīt. 1</ls>; <ls>Śi. 9. 71</ls>; so गो˚, कृमि˚, महिषी˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 A lot, gang, band (in a bad sense). .²6 A country. .²7 The body. .²8 The front or fore part. .²9 A tribe, caste, community. .²10 A blue stone. .{@-लः@} The head of a guild or corporation. .{@-ला@} See कुलतिथि.
